# Button

The standard SuDu AI button; primary is the single neon accent on a view, everything else is secondary or ghost.

`SuDuAI.Button` · Core

## Use

```jsx
<SuDuAI.Button>…</SuDuAI.Button>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SuDuAI.Button">…</x-import>
```

## Notes

The SuDu AI action button — primary neon CTA, hairline secondary, teal ghost, error danger.

## Props (ButtonProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` |  |
| `variant` | `'primary' \| 'secondary' \| 'ghost' \| 'danger'` | primary = neon #00F5A9 fill with glow; secondary = glass + hairline; ghost = teal text; danger = error container. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | sm uses label-sm, md/lg use label-lg. Default md. |
| `icon` | `string` | Material Symbols name rendered before the label. |
| `trailingIcon` | `string` | Material Symbols name pushed to the far edge (used by "New Synthesis"). |
| `fullWidth` | `boolean` |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  |
| `onClick` | `(e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => void` |  |
| `type` | `'button' \| 'submit' \| 'reset'` |  |
